                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const app = express();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Read Typesense API key from file or environment\n'[39m +

                  [32m'if (!typesenseApiKey) {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m"const typesenseHost = process.env.TYPESENSE_HOST || '127.0.0.1';\n"[39m +
                  [32m"const typesensePort = parseInt(process.env.TYPESENSE_PORT || '8108');\n"[39m +
                  [32m"const typesenseProtocol = process.env.TYPESENSE_PROTOCOL || 'http';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'const client = new Typesense.Client({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  nodes: [{\n'[39m +

                  [32m'});\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Helper to escape HTML to prevent XSS and DOM breaking\n'[39m +
                  [32m'function escapeHTML(str) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  if (!str) return '';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  return String(str)\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')\n"[39m +
                  [32m`    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')\n`[39m +
                  [32m"    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');\n"[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Idempotent Typesense initialization\n'[39m +
                  [32m'async function initTypesense() {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  console.log('Initializing Typesense collection...');\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    await client.collections('products').delete();\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    console.log('Existing products collection deleted.');\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  } catch (e) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // Collection did not exist, which is fine\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const schema = {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    fields: [\n'[39m +

                  [32m"      { name: 'brand', type: 'string', facet: true },\n"[39m +

                  [32m"      { name: 'price', type: 'float' }\n"[39m +

                  [32m"    default_sorting_field: 'popularity'\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  await client.collections().create(schema);\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  console.log('Products collection schema created.');\n"[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // Load products.jsonl\n'[39m +
                  [32m"  const jsonlPath = path.join(__dirname, 'data', 'products.jsonl');\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  if (!fs.existsSync(jsonlPath)) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    throw new Error(`Dataset file not found at ${jsonlPath}`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const fileStream = fs.createReadStream(jsonlPath);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const rl = readline.createInterface({\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    crlfDelay: Infinity\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  const documents = [];\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (documents.length > 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    console.log(`Importing ${documents.length} products into Typesense...`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    const importResults = await client.collections('products').documents().import(documents, { action: 'upsert' });\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    const failedImports = importResults.filter(res => res.success === false);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (failedImports.length > 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"      console.error('Some imports failed:', failedImports);\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    } else {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"      console.log('All products imported successfully.');\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  } else {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    console.warn('No products found in products.jsonl to import.');\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'// Serve search page\n'[39m +
                  [32m"app.get('/', async (req, res) => {\n"[39m +
                  [32m'  try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    const q = req.query.q || '';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    const pageParam = parseInt(req.query.page) || 1;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // Search Typesense\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    // q: q || '*' matches all products when q is empty\n"[39m +
                  [32m"    const searchResults = await client.collections('products').documents().search({\n"[39m +
                  [32m"      q: q || '*',\n"[39m +
                  [32m"      query_by: 'name',\n"[39m +

                  [32m'      per_page: 250 // Retrieve all matching products to perform pagination & grouping in Node\n'[39m +

                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // Group by brand\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const groupsMap = {};\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    for (const p of products) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (!groupsMap[p.brand]) {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'        };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // Convert to array and sort brand groups by maxPopularity descending\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const groups = Object.values(groupsMap);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    groups.sort((a, b) => b.maxPopularity - a.maxPopularity);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    // Sort items within each group by popularity descending (already sorted, but let's be explicit)\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    for (const g of groups) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      g.items.sort((a, b) => b.popularity - a.popularity);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +

                  [32m'\n'[39m +

                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const prevPageNum = currentPage > 1 ? currentPage - 1 : null;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const nextPageNum = currentPage < totalPages ? currentPage + 1 : null;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // Render HTML response\n'[39m +
                  [32m"    let groupsHtml = '';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'    if (pageGroups.length === 0) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m`      groupsHtml = '<div class="no-results">No products found matching your search.</div>';\n`[39m +
                  [32m'    } else {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      for (const g of pageGroups) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        const totalItems = g.items.length;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        const initialItems = g.items.slice(0, 3);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        const extraItems = g.items.slice(3);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m"        let itemsHtml = '';\n"[39m +
                  [32m'        for (const item of initialItems) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          itemsHtml += `\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            <div class="product-item" data-testid="item" data-id="${escapeHTML(item.id)}">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              <div class="product-header">\n'[39m +
                  [32m'                <span class="product-name">${escapeHTML(item.name)}</span>\n'[39m +

            [32m'# Committing changes with git\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Only create commits when requested by the user. If unclear, ask first. When the user asks you to create a new git commit, follow these steps carefully:\n'[39m +

            [32m'When using the newTask tool, the agentType parameter is optional. Leave it empty (None) to launch a generic sub agent, or specify one of the available agent types below to select a specialized agent.\n'[39m +
            [32m'Available agent types and the tools they have access to:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### browser\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### explore\n'[39m +
            [32m'Use this agent to explore the codebase when you need to: understand project structure, find where features are implemented, locate specific functions or classes, analyze code patterns, investigate how something works, search for examples or usage, or gather information before making changes.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of questions this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "where is the authentication logic implemented"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "find all usages of the config parser"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "how does the ignore-walk module work"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### guide\n'[39m +
            [32m"A comprehensive guide for learning about Pochi's capabilities, features, and configuration.\n"[39m +
            [32m'This agent helps users understand how to use Pochi effectively, fetch documentation, and modify their config file (.pochi/config.jsonc) with proper confirmation.\n'[39m +
            [32m"**IMPORTANT: Any request to modify Pochi's configuration must be handled by this agent.**\n"[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Trigger examples:\n'[39m +

            [32m'- Configuration: "how do I configure Pochi?", "explain config options", "help me modify my config", "set up a new provider", "add an MCP server"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- Help & feedback: "join the discord", "report a bug", "where can I get help?"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### planner\n'[39m +
            [32m'Engage this agent to formulate comprehensive, technical implementation strategies for feature development, system refactoring, or defect resolution.\n'[39m +
            [32m'This agent is strictly limited to planning and architectural design; it DOES NOT execute code modifications.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of user requests this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "create a plan to implement the user authentication feature"\n'[39m +

            [32m'- "design a solution for the memory leak issue"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Always include a reminder in your prompt to ensure the result will be submitted through the `attemptCompletion` tool.\n'[39m +

            [32m'When NOT to use the newTask tool:\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'3. Each agent invocation is stateless. You will not be able to send additional messages to the agent, nor will the agent be able to communicate with you outside of its final report.
